tasks.short: Observe equipment use against quality standards

steps.what: Verify equipment operation and maintenance by observing worker performance

tasks.design: Keep direct observation and comparison with standards with the technician. Existing standards in {DOCS} support the work; no new worker-monitoring system is proposed.
tasks.previous_blocker: A sensor value does not establish how a worker operated or maintained equipment.
tasks.enabler_now: No automation change is proposed for this observation task.
tasks.still_hard: Distinguish a deviation from an appropriate response to unusual conditions.
tasks.human_edge: Understand the physical context and ask the worker what happened.
tasks.altitude: Observation duties and quality decision rights remain unchanged.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: direct observation of equipment use involves situational assessment; no measured saving is established.

assumptions: Boundary is technician observation and assessment, excluding equipment maintenance and employee appraisal.

The quality engineer supplies applicable standards before observation. The technician produces the observed action, conditions, standard reference and uncertainty in s1; all capture and clarification time remains. No structured compliant-worker flag is assumed.
Test native standards access before custom tools; no new configuration is proposed.
Zero incremental upkeep follows from unchanged observation and existing equipment.
research_questions: Is any repetitive record preparation separate from the actual observation?

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B=100, R=100, incremental=0; net=0. Routine operations and unusual maintenance conditions retain full observation and judgement time.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

steps.what: Establish material requirements, processing options and current production constraints
Calculate material quantities and comparable processing metrics for defined options
Select material quantities or processing methods using the evidence and production context

tasks.design: Configure protected calculations in {SPREADSHEET} from verified production inputs. Keep method selection and the recommendation to engineering human; no live process setting changes.
tasks.previous_blocker: Recalculating defined quantities can interrupt evaluation of the actual production trade-offs.
tasks.enabler_now: Native formulas can compare explicitly defined options reproducibly.
tasks.still_hard: Judge process suitability when yields and physical conditions change.
tasks.human_edge: Reject a numerically attractive option that is operationally unsuitable.
tasks.altitude: Less arithmetic, unchanged technical recommendation authority.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: defined quantity and processing calculations can use protected formulas; this does not automate method selection or establish local savings.

assumptions: Boundary is quantity and method recommendation, excluding trials, purchasing and production changes.

The technician produces required output, units, material revision, loss assumptions, option parameters, calculation formulas and uncertainty in s1. Manual extraction, measurement interpretation and capture retain the full 30%; missing yields or compatibility facts return to manual investigation.
s2 uses only the s1 verified inputs and stops on missing units or undefined formulas. No free feasible-method flag is assumed.
Test existing native calculation features first. Engineer approval of implementation remains an unchanged outside process.
unknowns: Existing calculation automation and frequency of comparable options
research_questions: Is repeated arithmetic a real 20% share after input collection?

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B=100, R=30+0+50=80; gross=20, incremental=6, net=14. Range 0-5 allows existing formulas or uncertain yield inputs to erase most arithmetic gain; physical trials and selection remain unchanged.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

steps.what: Monitor production processes and diagnose quality or productivity deviations
Adjust equipment within authority and verify the resulting production response

tasks.design: Keep diagnosis, physical adjustment and response verification with the technician. Existing {OPS_SYSTEM} instrumentation continues to support the work without claiming its runtime as human savings.
tasks.previous_blocker: A process deviation needs diagnosis before an appropriate adjustment can be chosen.
tasks.enabler_now: Existing instrumentation already supplies readings; no new control automation is proposed.
tasks.still_hard: Identify causes and distinguish a transient response from a stable improvement.
tasks.human_edge: Recognise when to stop adjusting and escalate an unfamiliar condition.
tasks.altitude: Process duties and adjustment authority remain unchanged.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: existing automatic equipment operation is not removable technician labour; diagnosis and adjustment remain human in this proposal.

assumptions: Boundary is technician monitoring and permitted adjustment, excluding machine runtime and engineering redesign.

The responsible engineer supplies operating and adjustment limits before work. The technician checks instrument context, physical condition and deviation meaning in s1. No free structured safe-adjustment flag is assumed; uncertain conditions are manually escalated.
The process produces response observations after each adjustment and before the technician judges that adjustment complete in s2; verification time remains in its full 50% share.
Test native instrumentation configuration before custom tools. Incremental upkeep is zero because current equipment and duties remain unchanged.
unknowns: Equipment, existing controls and delegated adjustment limits
research_questions: Is there avoidable display navigation separate from physical diagnosis and adjustment?

approvals.approved_version: Exact equipment, current condition, selected setting, permitted limit and adjustment checked immediately before action; changes void approval.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B=100, R=50+50=100, incremental=0, net=0. Stable production and unfamiliar deviations retain technician monitoring, adjustment and verification time.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Assist engineers with prototypes and new processes

steps.what: Assist engineers in developing, building or testing prototypes and new production procedures

tasks.design: Keep hands-on prototype assistance and interpretation with the technician under engineering direction. {DOCS} holds the existing instructions and observations; no separate report-writing share is assumed.
tasks.previous_blocker: A new prototype requires adaptation to physical conditions and unexpected findings.
tasks.enabler_now: Existing plans and test equipment support the work; no new automation is proposed.
tasks.still_hard: Build correctly, notice abnormal behaviour and produce observations an engineer can interpret.
tasks.human_edge: Handle the physical prototype and recognise a test result that challenges the plan.
tasks.altitude: Hands-on duties and engineering authority remain unchanged.

reach.task: Explain a prototype assembly or test problem

evidence.claim: DewesoftX records test data and produces reports; this adjacent documentation capability does not remove physical prototype development, assembly or testing.

assumptions: Boundary is hands-on assistance, excluding engineer design authority and any separately measured formal report preparation.

The engineer supplies instructions, permitted test conditions and existing authorisation before the relevant activity. The technician captures materials, configuration and observations during s1; test results arise after execution before interpretation. No free working-prototype or passed-test flag is assumed.
Unclear instructions or unexpected behaviour return to the engineer within the retained work; no independent machine action is introduced.
Test native test-recording facilities before custom tools. Incremental upkeep is zero because equipment and workflow are unchanged.
unknowns: Prototype type and actual mix of development, build and test assistance
research_questions: Is test documentation a distinct repetitive activity rather than part of physical execution?

already_counted.description: Physical assistance, clarification and observation capture

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B=100, R=100, incremental=0, net=0. Straightforward assembly and unexpected prototype behaviour retain hands-on assistance; no generic reporting baseline is invented.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

role.altitude: Use explicit calculations where justified while retaining observation, physical adjustment and prototype assistance.
reach: Explain material trade-offs and process responses to engineering colleagues.
role.ambitious_version: A technician who can reproduce calculations and defend physical observations without delegating engineering judgement.
